_description: Default weights of the global layout score (one shared source read by the site and the app through _shared/ui/layout_analysis/_generated/analysis_data.js). Each weight is the number of score points one unit of the metric is worth (one percentage point, or one millimetre for distance); the sign comes from the metric's direction, so every weight is positive. « floors » gives each penalty metric (lower is better) a floor in its own unit: only the part of its value above the floor costs points (Cyanophage's optimiser), so tiny differences between good layouts do not decide the rank; 0, the default, counts the whole value. The maintainer weighed pinky_ring 0.14 on 2026-11-24 (Oxeylyzer's ratio of its pinky–ring weight to its SFB weight beside sfb 5), every floor staying 0. The maintainer set sfb 5 and sfb_distance 0.26 (a 1 u SFB keeps costing about 10: 5 + 0.26 × 19.05 mm; 0.5, applied first the same day, made it 14.8) and the access weights altgr_usage 5 and dead_key_usage 3 on 2026-11-19 (docs/memory/maintainer-decisions.md). « grades » are the graded costs (maintainer, 2026-11-21): each factor table multiplies its metric's weight by the kind of event, so one weight stays the base and the grades its scale. sfb by the rows the finger crosses (same_row, one_row, two_rows: two or more); row_jump, the maintainer's « skipgram » (two different fingers of one hand on different rows: one finger's jump is an SFB), by its fingers (adjacent, one_apart: a finger between them, index_pinky) times its rows (one_row, two_rows: two or more); distance by the finger that travels (pinky, ring, middle, index, thumb). Two tables are settings: alternation.rewarded (true or false) says whether the alternation weight rewards hand alternation at all, and hand_run is the progressive scale of same-hand runs (maintainer): each keystroke weighs the multiplier of the run of one hand it is in, length_1 (a perfect alternation, 1) to length_6, then length_6 plus growth per key beyond (linear: 3 keys 2, 4 keys 3, and so on), and hand_run's value is how much more a keystroke weighs than in a perfect alternation (100 × (mean multiplier − 1), %). Every factor at 1, the alternation rewarded, and row_jump's and hand_run's weights at 0 give the single weights' score to the last bit (the flat model). The shipped values are the agent's scale, proposed on 2026-11-21 from Cyanophage, genkey, Oxeylyzer and the Keyboard Layout Optimizer and shipped after its ranking-impact report (docs/audits/layout-analysers/graded-costs-ranking.md; to review by the maintainer). The choice of each other value is justified in docs/audits/layout-analysers/report.md, section « Default weights ». « change_penalty » is the optimizer's cost of leaving its start layout, in score points per % of the corpus's characters moved (each weighted by its occurrences, as layoutSimilarity weighs them): its presets, the one a page starts on, the largest weight its slider offers, and the number its « at most N changed characters » starts on (docs/design/layout-optimizer.md, « Change penalty »; decided by the agent on 2026-11-19, to review by the maintainer).
